title: How I Track Crazy Tech IPOs
description:
Head to Hyperagent.com/matt to get $1,000 in free credits for Hyperagent!

I’m building a new monetizable business every month with AI.

First up: an AI Finance Dashboard, because keeping up with all the investing/IPO/finance info right now seems almost impossible.

So I built a team of AI agents with @Hyperagentapp that can:
• Monitor company news
• Track funding rounds and IPO activity
• Analyze sentiment and trends
• Turn it all into a clean dashboard

The agents run in the background like a small research team, so I can spot what matters without manually digging through dozens of sources.

Episode 1 of this challenge: complete ✅
